Pakistan Faces Economic and Cricket Management Challenges

Pakistan is reportedly facing significant challenges on multiple fronts. In its cricket administration, a major change is anticipated, with Mohsin Naqvi expected to remove two prominent figures to secure his position. Concurrently, the nation is experiencing severe economic strain, exacerbated by a depleted treasury and rising oil prices, leading to speculation about potential lockdowns. This economic crisis is described as a 'double blow' to the country.
